descriptions.notStarted: Muirhat is worried about the evil spirits that have infiltrated Victoria Island as of late. I wonder what I could do to help? I should go talk to Muirhat on the top deck of The Nautilus.
descriptions.inProgress: Victoria Island has already been infused with evil spirits. But I refuse to give up like this. I need to eliminate #r100 Stone Golems#k to stop these evil creatures from further spreading their evilness in Victoria Island.  \n\n#o 5130101# #r#a21981##k
descriptions.completed: I've eliminated 100 Stone Golems. I wonder if I've made a difference in Victoria Island?
